event_name: Rich Energy Haas F1 Team Document 37 Date 09 June 2019 Time 12:31 2019 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 6 - 9 June 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 36), have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 23.5 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The gearbox of car 20 has been changed before 6 consecutive events have expired. This penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start from the Pit Lane for a prior infringement (document 32).
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 20 Gearbox Change
